thread_text:
Alex: early-afternoon pager — noticed a sudden surge of 503s from inference-eu1 around 12:02. error rate jumped to ~12% on production read route, p95 latency up to 4.2s. tagging primary/secondary.
IncidentBot: Pager created: SEV2 - inference-eu1 503 surge. Pager link: https://pager.redwood/incident/INC-17660022 :rotating_light:
Alex: Ops dashboard snapshot -> https://dash.redwood/infer/eu1?range=5m
OpsBot: metric: requests/5m = 18k, errors/5m = 2.2k, error_ratio = 0.122, avg_latency = 1.9s, p95=4.2s
Sam: I'm primary for this rotation. I'm on a call for another pager but can jump in. @Maria can you stand up as secondary until I clear the other page? :hand:
Maria: I can take secondary. quick note: I saw autoscaler logs showing a ton of short-lived pods in eu1 last hour. might be cascading scale thrash.
Jin: adding context — KV cache hit-rate for embeddings route dropped from 88% to 30% right before the spike. suspect cache leader churn + heavy cold starts causing backend queueing.
Alex: good theory. can we toggle cache fallback for a short window to reduce load? runbook link: https://runbooks.redwood/kv-leader-churn
Maria: I'm at my workstation. Sam, if you confirm you want me to, I'll flip the cache fallback for embeddings and pin routing to smaller model variant for eu1.
Sam: do it. I'll handle routing fallback policy after I finish the other pager (eta ~6-7 min).
Maria: performing quick mitigation: enabling cache-fallback mode and pinning route -> smaller-model-eu. will post commands.
Maria: ```
# set route override for eu1 to smaller model
curl -X POST "https://controlplane.redwood/api/v1/routing/overrides" \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer $ADMIN_TOKEN" \
  -H "Content-Type: application/json" \
  -d '{"region":"eu1","route":"/v1/generate","target_model":"gpt-small-eu","ttl":300}'

# enable cache-fallback (kv prefix disabled for embeddings)
curl -X POST "https://controlplane.redwood/api/v1/cache/fallback" -H "Authorization: Bearer $ADMIN_TOKEN" -d '{"region":"eu1","enable":true}'
```
Maria: commands executed. OpsBot, confirm new routing config and cache-fallback status?
OpsBot: routing override applied for region=eu1 target=gpt-small-eu ttl=300s
OpsBot: cache-fallback enabled for embeddings in eu1 (reason: manual-mitigation by Maria)
Alex: logs around the time of the mitigation:
Alex: ```
[12:01:42] infer-eu1-01 - p95 3.9s - 503 spike
[12:02:10] autoscaler - created 12 pods in 20s
[12:02:34] kv-leader - leader change detected
[12:03:12] infer-eu1-02 - p95 5.1s - 503s rising
```
Jin: after the override, error_ratio dropped to 3.4% in the next 90s. nice.
OpsBot: metric update (post-mitigation): requests/5m = 17.8k, errors/5m = 610, error_ratio = 0.034, p95=1.1s
Sam: joining now. quick check: any customer-impacted tenants flagged? Alex: SRE noted ~7 customers saw degraded responses, none yet escalated to support. I created a short incident note in Jira: https://jira.redwood/browse/RINF-1766
Sam: good. plan next steps: 1) let override run for 10m, 2) scrub autoscaler configs for burst thresholds, 3) follow up runbook to stabilize KV leader election, 4) if errors <1% after 10m, revert routing.
Maria: adding immediate action item: run a controlled pod replacement for one faulty node to test leader stability. I'll run `kubectl rollout restart` on the embedding-service group in eu1 once Sam gives the go.
Jin: also recommend a short-term tweak to autoscaler cooldown from 30s to 60s to avoid thrash. we'll open a ticket for proper tuning.
Alex: documenting for handoff: primary = Sam (will remain after he clears other pager), secondary = Maria (staying on), on-call notes = applied routing override + cache-fallback, observed error_ratio drop to ~3%. Next steps saved in incident ticket RINF-1766. Runbook refs: kv-leader-churn, routing-overrides, autoscaler-tuning.
Sam: confirmed primary ownership. I'll monitor for next 20m and then hand off to Maria at 12:40 if stable. I'll also start the controlled pod replacement now.
Sam: ```
# controlled restart for embedding-service in eu1
kubectl -n inference rollout restart deploy/embedding-service-eu1 --context=eu1-cluster
```
Maria: noted. I'll watch logs and customer-facing dashboards. If error_ratio creeps up >5% we escalate to SEV1 and open an incident bridge.
IncidentBot: Reminder: please add a short post-incident summary to the ticket once this stabilizes. :memo:
Alex: quick log snippet after restart/override:
Alex: ```
[12:07:10] infer-eu1-03 - p95 1.2s - 200 OK
[12:08:00] autoscaler - scaled down 4 pods (stability)
[12:09:22] kv-leader - leader settled
```
Jin: looks stable. I'll follow up with a PR for autoscaler tuning and a short note on leader-election metrics.
Alex: handoff summary for night rotation: primary Sam (monitoring until 12:40), secondary Maria, actions taken = routing override -> gpt-small-eu, cache-fallback enabled, controlled restart of embedding-service, incident ticket RINF-1766 created. Customer impact = degraded responses for ~7 tenants, no escalations yet. Next steps = autoscaler tuning ticket, runbook update for leader churn, revert override after 10m of stability.
Sam: leaving final watch. ping me if anything flares in the next 15m. :eyes:
Maria: will take handoff at 12:40 if stable, will post final signoff then. :white_check_mark:
IncidentBot: Pager closed: SEV2 resolved (temporary mitigation applied). Link: https://pager.redwood/incident/INC-17660022/resolve
Alex: thanks team — please paste the final short blameless summary into RINF-1766 once we revert routing.
Maria: final signoff at 12:42: system stable, metrics normal, handing over to next rotation.```
